top_signals.title: Big Take: If You Work, Are You ‘Working Class’?
top_signals.summary: The definition of "working class" in the US has been shifting over the last couple of decades with changes in the economic and labor market, and advances in AI are going to change the traditional white collar market, too. With midterms right around the corner, who are candidates talking about talking about when they campaign for the working class vote? (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Nike parts ways with Kylian Mbappé, soccer superstar signs with On
top_signals.summary: Mbappe had been signed with Nike for roughly two decades, and his agreement with On is the first it has made with a soccer player.
